M0.reason: Direct NVML component W cannot be added one-for-one to a different-boundary equivalent IT anchor; HIGH also exceeds the anchor under a false containment interpretation.

M1.reason: Measured active/idle ratio modulates the frozen equivalent active-state coefficient and preserves the full-active anchor.

M2.reason: Predeclared min(d_direct,d_anchor) retains the measured component swing as an upper bound and the anchor-consistent modulation bound.

M3.reason: The frozen strict-F0 coefficient is exactly c_ref, so M3 is mathematically equivalent to M1.
